input.standard: ASTM E741 concentration decay; ASTM D6245 occupant CO2 tracer
input.purpose: Measure V_lab, the air volume served by /habitat/lab/eclss/scrubber-1-v7.
hypotheses: The Lab is a single well-mixed zone during both phases.
The closed /habitat/lab/hatch-1-v7 has nonzero but sufficiently small exchange with Hab-B that it does not dominate the fitted Lab decay; Hab-B CO2 is recorded to test this hypothesis.
The three Lab occupants remain in the Lab at steady activity throughout; any entry, exit, or additional person invalidates the curve and triggers the vitals/occupancy abort.
The scrubber's registered effective flow scales with commanded speed and is stable after its response lag.
An initial engineering volume guess of 30 m3 and full-speed effective flow of 1 m3/min give tau about 30 min; the fitted result, not this guess, is reported.
Fit the full-speed decay to C(t)=C_eq+(C_0-C_eq) exp(-t/tau), then calculate V_lab=Qe*tau; do not fit toward zero or outdoor concentration.

monitoring.reason: The occupied-zone test deliberately raises CO2; abort on abnormal or lost vitals.

steps.why: Hold all openings closed and occupants/activity steady; record Lab and Hab-B CO2, accepted command, speed, occupancy, and vitals each minute while Lab CO2 rises several hundred ppm, never exceeding the limit.
Keep identical boundary and source conditions; record the same channels each minute and fit the full-speed decay toward its fitted equilibrium.

abort.when: Lab CO2 is at or above 3000 ppm, or the required CO2 reading cannot be read.
The scrubber refuses either commanded speed.
Scrubber battery state of charge is below threshold percent, or cannot be read.
Any monitored subject leaves the 45–120 bpm band, monitoring is lost, or any person enters or leaves the Lab.

expected.rise: From the measured 1050 ppm start, 30% speed should produce a clear rise of several hundred ppm above sensor noise while remaining below 2800 ppm.
expected.decay: At 100% speed, Lab CO2 should show a monotonic exponential approach to a nonzero fitted equilibrium after the scrubber response lag.
expected.volume: Fit tau from the one-minute Lab record and report V_lab=Qe*tau in m3 with fit residuals and uncertainty.
expected.openingCheck: Hab-B CO2 should not show a synchronous Lab-sized transient; a correlated transient indicates significant closed-hatch exchange and rejects the one-zone hypothesis.
expected.rejection: Reject the result if the rise is not distinguishable from noise, the decay is not exponential toward a stable nonzero equilibrium, occupancy/activity changes, a command is refused, an abort occurs, or connected-zone exchange is material.
